entry.title: VS Code v1_146: Trust and security
entry.summary: Improved permission prompts The Copilot harness previously suggested overly broad tool-level allowances for operations like web fetches, terminal commands, and file reads. For example, the default action for fetching a URL was "Allow in this Session", which would let the model access any URL during that session. Now, permission prompts are more granular, by default adding allowances for specific domains, commands, and directories.
